# NEW 2026-11-19 v6.4 D1 phase 1, X1 Italian commercial privileges (oe_itp_). Generated by gen_italian_privileges.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope. Test-page counter of fired X1 events.
oe_itp_count = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dbg_n_itp } change_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_itp add = 1 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_itp value = 1 } }
}

# BYZ scope. Take this month's main-line lock as line 15 and count the event.
oe_itp_take = {
    oe_ml_take_as = { line = 15 }
    oe_itp_count = yes
}

# Any scope. Imperial Authority $amount$ (negative = a cost), kept within 0-100.
oe_itp_auth = {
    international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
        change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = $amount$ }
        clamp_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority min = 0 max = 100 }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Interface (design 4.2): the Venetian claims change by $kd$ thousand ducats (negative = paid off), never below 0.
oe_itp_add_claims = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_itp_ven_claims } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_ven_claims value = 0 }
    }
    change_variable = { name = oe_itp_ven_claims add = $kd$ }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_itp_ven_claims min = 0 max = 1000 }
}

# BYZ scope. The Venetian treaty runs again for 60 months; no longer lapsed.
oe_itp_pact_renewed = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_itp_ven_pact_m value = 60 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_ven_lapsed } remove_variable = oe_itp_ven_lapsed }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_itp_no_pact_ven } remove_country_modifier = oe_itp_no_pact_ven }
}

# BYZ scope. Venice one tier up, within its cap. 1 -> 2: the duties on them end, the strait toll exemption is given if missing; 2 -> 3: the pledge modifier, fleet basing rights, 240 months, their opinion +30 and the rival's -10.
oe_itp_up_ven = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:VEN oe_itp_room_ven = yes }
        change_variable = { name = oe_itp_t_ven add = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_itp_t_ven ?= 2 }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_itp_recall_ven } remove_country_modifier = oe_itp_recall_ven }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    country_exists = c:VEN
                    NOT = { giving_scripted_relation = { type = relation_type:sound_toll_exemption target = c:VEN } }
                }
                create_relation = { type = relation_type:sound_toll_exemption first = c:BYZ second = c:VEN }
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_itp_t_ven ?= 3 }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_itp_pledge_ven mode = replace }
            set_variable = { name = oe_itp_t3m_ven value = 240 }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    country_exists = c:VEN
                    NOT = { giving_scripted_relation = { type = relation_type:fleet_basing_rights target = c:VEN } }
                }
                create_relation = { type = relation_type:fleet_basing_rights first = c:BYZ second = c:VEN }
            }
            c:VEN ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_t3 target = c:BYZ } }
            c:GEN ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_rival target = c:BYZ } }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Venice one tier down. 3 -> 2: pledge, basing rights and the +30 go; 2 -> 1: we levy duties on them (the exemption stays).
oe_itp_dn_ven = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_t_ven var:oe_itp_t_ven >= 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_itp_t_ven ?= 3 }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_itp_pledge_ven } remove_country_modifier = oe_itp_pledge_ven }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_t3m_ven } remove_variable = oe_itp_t3m_ven }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_q13_ven } remove_variable = oe_itp_q13_ven }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    country_exists = c:VEN
                    giving_scripted_relation = { type = relation_type:fleet_basing_rights target = c:VEN }
                }
                remove_relation = { type = relation_type:fleet_basing_rights first = c:BYZ second = c:VEN }
            }
            c:VEN ?= {
                if = {
                    limit = { has_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_t3 target = c:BYZ } }
                    remove_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_t3 target = c:BYZ }
                }
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_itp_t_ven ?= 2 }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_itp_recall_ven mode = replace }
        }
        change_variable = { name = oe_itp_t_ven add = -1 }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Venice's slot back to 0: every X1 modifier, relation, tier-bound opinion and timer of the slot goes (a republic that no longer exists; the test reset).
oe_itp_clear_ven = {
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_itp_pledge_ven } remove_country_modifier = oe_itp_pledge_ven }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_itp_recall_ven } remove_country_modifier = oe_itp_recall_ven }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_itp_no_pact_ven } remove_country_modifier = oe_itp_no_pact_ven }
    if = {
        limit = {
            country_exists = c:VEN
            giving_scripted_relation = { type = relation_type:fleet_basing_rights target = c:VEN }
        }
        remove_relation = { type = relation_type:fleet_basing_rights first = c:BYZ second = c:VEN }
    }
    c:VEN ?= {
        if = {
            limit = { has_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_t3 target = c:BYZ } }
            remove_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_t3 target = c:BYZ }
        }
    }
    c:VEN ?= {
        if = {
            limit = { has_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_t2 target = c:BYZ } }
            remove_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_t2 target = c:BYZ }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_t3m_ven } remove_variable = oe_itp_t3m_ven }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_q13_ven } remove_variable = oe_itp_q13_ven }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_q9_ven } remove_variable = oe_itp_q9_ven }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_rep_ven } remove_variable = oe_itp_rep_ven }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_rep_why_ven } remove_variable = oe_itp_rep_why_ven }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_rep2_ven } remove_variable = oe_itp_rep2_ven }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_q4_ven } remove_variable = oe_itp_q4_ven }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_ven_lapsed } remove_variable = oe_itp_ven_lapsed }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_ven_pact_m } remove_variable = oe_itp_ven_pact_m }
    set_variable = { name = oe_itp_t_ven value = 0 }
}

# BYZ scope. Venice one tier up ($n$ > 0) or down ($n$ < 0).
oe_itp_shift_ven = {
    save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_itp_n value = $n$ }
    if = { limit = { scope:oe_itp_n > 0 } oe_itp_up_ven = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { scope:oe_itp_n < 0 } oe_itp_dn_ven = yes }
}

# BYZ scope. A reprisal from Venice in 3-9 months (.4); set oe_itp_rep_why_<r> after it (1 revoked, 2 lapsed).
oe_itp_rep_set_ven = {
    random_list = {
        1 = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_rep_ven value = 3 } }
        1 = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_rep_ven value = 4 } }
        1 = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_rep_ven value = 5 } }
        1 = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_rep_ven value = 6 } }
        1 = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_rep_ven value = 7 } }
        1 = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_rep_ven value = 8 } }
        1 = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_rep_ven value = 9 } }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Pisa one tier up, within its cap. 1 -> 2: the exemption modifier, the strait toll exemption, their opinion +10.
oe_itp_up_pis = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:PIS oe_itp_room_pis = yes }
        change_variable = { name = oe_itp_t_pis add = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_itp_t_pis ?= 2 }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_itp_exempt_pis mode = replace }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    country_exists = c:PIS
                    NOT = { giving_scripted_relation = { type = relation_type:sound_toll_exemption target = c:PIS } }
                }
                create_relation = { type = relation_type:sound_toll_exemption first = c:BYZ second = c:PIS }
            }
            c:PIS ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_t2 target = c:BYZ } }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Pisa one tier down. 2 -> 1: all of that is taken back.
oe_itp_dn_pis = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_t_pis var:oe_itp_t_pis >= 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_itp_t_pis ?= 2 }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_itp_exempt_pis } remove_country_modifier = oe_itp_exempt_pis }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    country_exists = c:PIS
                    giving_scripted_relation = { type = relation_type:sound_toll_exemption target = c:PIS }
                }
                remove_relation = { type = relation_type:sound_toll_exemption first = c:BYZ second = c:PIS }
            }
            c:PIS ?= {
                if = {
                    limit = { has_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_t2 target = c:BYZ } }
                    remove_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_t2 target = c:BYZ }
                }
            }
        }
        change_variable = { name = oe_itp_t_pis add = -1 }
    }
}

    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_rep_why_rag } remove_variable = oe_itp_rep_why_rag }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_rep2_rag } remove_variable = oe_itp_rep2_rag }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_q4_rag } remove_variable = oe_itp_q4_rag }
    set_variable = { name = oe_itp_t_rag value = 0 }
}

# BYZ scope. Ragusa one tier up ($n$ > 0) or down ($n$ < 0).
oe_itp_shift_rag = {
    save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_itp_n value = $n$ }
    if = { limit = { scope:oe_itp_n > 0 } oe_itp_up_rag = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { scope:oe_itp_n < 0 } oe_itp_dn_rag = yes }
}

# BYZ scope. A reprisal from Ragusa in 3-9 months (.4); set oe_itp_rep_why_<r> after it (1 revoked, 2 lapsed).
oe_itp_rep_set_rag = {
    random_list = {
        1 = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_rep_rag value = 3 } }
        1 = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_rep_rag value = 4 } }
        1 = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_rep_rag value = 5 } }
        1 = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_rep_rag value = 6 } }
        1 = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_rep_rag value = 7 } }
        1 = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_rep_rag value = 8 } }
        1 = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_rep_rag value = 9 } }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Interface (design 4.2): oe_itp_shift = { r = ven n = -1 } - one tier up or down; modifiers, relations, opinions and caps follow. Only the sign of n counts.
oe_itp_shift = {
    oe_itp_shift_$r$ = { n = $n$ }
}

# BYZ scope. Venice straight to tier 3 (as far as its cap allows) with $months$ months left.
oe_itp_pledge_ven = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_t_ven var:oe_itp_t_ven < 2 } oe_itp_up_ven = yes }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_t_ven ?= 1 } oe_itp_up_ven = yes }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_t_ven ?= 2 } oe_itp_up_ven = yes }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_t_ven ?= 3 } set_variable = { name = oe_itp_t3m_ven value = $months$ } }
}

# BYZ scope. Genoa straight to tier 3 (as far as its cap allows) with $months$ months left.
oe_itp_pledge_gen = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_t_gen var:oe_itp_t_gen < 2 } oe_itp_up_gen = yes }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_t_gen ?= 1 } oe_itp_up_gen = yes }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_t_gen ?= 2 } oe_itp_up_gen = yes }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_t_gen ?= 3 } set_variable = { name = oe_itp_t3m_gen value = $months$ } }
}

# BYZ scope. Interface (design 4.2): oe_itp_pledge = { r = ven months = 240 } (ven or gen).
oe_itp_pledge = {
    oe_itp_pledge_$r$ = { months = $months$ }
}

# BYZ scope. The start state (design 3.2): ven 2, gen 2, pis 1, rag 1 (0 for a republic that does not exist; Ragusa 1 anyway as a Venetian subject), the Venetian treaty due in 36-60 months, no claims. No modifier, relation or opinion.
oe_itp_set_start = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:VEN } set_variable = { name = oe_itp_t_ven value = 2 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_t_ven value = 0 } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:GEN } set_variable = { name = oe_itp_t_gen value = 2 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_t_gen value = 0 } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:PIS } set_variable = { name = oe_itp_t_pis value = 1 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_t_pis value = 0 } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:RAG } set_variable = { name = oe_itp_t_rag value = 1 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_t_rag value = 0 } }
    random_list = {
        1 = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_ven_pact_m value = 36 } }
        1 = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_ven_pact_m value = 42 } }
        1 = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_ven_pact_m value = 48 } }
        1 = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_ven_pact_m value = 54 } }
        1 = { set_variable = { name = oe_itp_ven_pact_m value = 60 } }
    }
    set_variable = { name = oe_itp_ven_claims value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_itp_slot4 value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_itp_cd value = 0 }
}

# BYZ scope, the first monthly call. The start state, and which foreign quarters stand in Constantinople now (their loss later lowers the cap of Venice / Genoa).
oe_itp_init = {
    set_variable = oe_itp_on
    oe_itp_set_start = yes
    if = {
        limit = { location:constantinople = { has_building = building_type:venetian_quarter } }
        set_variable = oe_itp_q_ven
    }
    if = { limit = { location:constantinople = { has_building = building_type:galata } } set_variable = oe_itp_q_gen }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly, also while paused. In order: a republic gone -> its slot 0; caps (expulsion: Venice / Genoa 3 -> 2 and .9 queued; Ragusa as a Venetian subject 2 -> 1); the Galata chain's result, once (abolished: Genoa 2 -> 1 without our duties, .5 queued; the peace of 1352: Venice frozen 60 months); B1's Venetian loan (+5 claims), Tenedos (claims 0), the Tenedos dispute (frozen), Turin (thawed), each once; timers (treaty, pledge -> .13 queued, reprisal -> .4 queued, cooldown).
oe_itp_sync = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { country_exists = c:VEN } has_variable = oe_itp_t_ven var:oe_itp_t_ven > 0 }
        oe_itp_clear_ven = yes
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { country_exists = c:GEN } has_variable = oe_itp_t_gen var:oe_itp_t_gen > 0 }
        oe_itp_clear_gen = yes
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { country_exists = c:PIS } has_variable = oe_itp_t_pis var:oe_itp_t_pis > 0 }
        oe_itp_clear_pis = yes
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { country_exists = c:RAG } has_variable = oe_itp_t_rag var:oe_itp_t_rag > 0 }
        oe_itp_clear_rag = yes
    }
    if = { limit = { oe_itp_over_ven = yes } set_variable = oe_itp_q9_ven oe_itp_dn_ven = yes }
    if = { limit = { oe_itp_over_gen = yes } set_variable = oe_itp_q9_gen oe_itp_dn_gen = yes }
    if = { limit = { oe_itp_over_pis = yes } oe_itp_dn_pis = yes }
    if = { limit = { oe_itp_over_rag = yes } oe_itp_dn_rag = yes }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_s37_gal_done NOT = { has_variable = oe_itp_seen_gal } }
        set_variable = oe_itp_seen_gal
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { has_variable = oe_ir_expel_done }
                country_exists = c:GEN
                NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_s37_galata }
                NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_s37_gal_curbed }
            }
            if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_t_gen ?= 3 } oe_itp_dn_gen = yes }
            if = {
                limit = { var:oe_itp_t_gen ?= 2 }
                set_variable = { name = oe_itp_t_gen value = 1 }
                set_variable = oe_itp_q5
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_s37_galata var:oe_s37_gal_r5 ?= 2 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_itp_ven_frozen months = 60 }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_cw2_venice NOT = { has_variable = oe_itp_seen_cw2v } }
        set_variable = oe_itp_seen_cw2v
        oe_itp_add_claims = { kd = 5 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = { has_country_modifier = oe_br_tenedos has_country_modifier = oe_vas_tenedos_ven }
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_itp_seen_ten }
        }
        set_variable = oe_itp_seen_ten
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_ven_claims value = 0 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_vas_tenedos_dispute NOT = { has_variable = oe_itp_seen_disp } }
        set_variable = oe_itp_seen_disp
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_ven_frozen months = 60 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_vas_done_17 NOT = { has_variable = oe_itp_seen_turin } }
        set_variable = oe_itp_seen_turin
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_ven_frozen } remove_variable = oe_itp_ven_frozen }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            country_exists = c:VEN
            oe_itp_t_ge1_ven = yes
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_itp_ven_frozen }
            has_variable = oe_itp_ven_pact_m
            var:oe_itp_ven_pact_m > 0
        }
        change_variable = { name = oe_itp_ven_pact_m add = -1 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_itp_t_ven ?= 3 has_variable = oe_itp_t3m_ven var:oe_itp_t3m_ven > 0 }
        change_variable = { name = oe_itp_t3m_ven add = -1 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_t3m_ven <= 0 } set_variable = oe_itp_q13_ven }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_itp_t_gen ?= 3 has_variable = oe_itp_t3m_gen var:oe_itp_t3m_gen > 0 }
        change_variable = { name = oe_itp_t3m_gen add = -1 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_t3m_gen <= 0 } set_variable = oe_itp_q13_gen }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_rep_ven }
        change_variable = { name = oe_itp_rep_ven add = -1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_itp_rep_ven <= 0 }
            remove_variable = oe_itp_rep_ven
            if = { limit = { country_exists = c:VEN } set_variable = oe_itp_q4_ven }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_rep_gen }
        change_variable = { name = oe_itp_rep_gen add = -1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_itp_rep_gen <= 0 }
            remove_variable = oe_itp_rep_gen
            if = { limit = { country_exists = c:GEN } set_variable = oe_itp_q4_gen }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_rep_pis }
        change_variable = { name = oe_itp_rep_pis add = -1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_itp_rep_pis <= 0 }
            remove_variable = oe_itp_rep_pis
            if = { limit = { country_exists = c:PIS } set_variable = oe_itp_q4_pis }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_rep_rag }
        change_variable = { name = oe_itp_rep_rag add = -1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_itp_rep_rag <= 0 }
            remove_variable = oe_itp_rep_rag
            if = { limit = { country_exists = c:RAG } set_variable = oe_itp_q4_rag }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_cd var:oe_itp_cd > 0 } change_variable = { name = oe_itp_cd add = -1 } }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly when not paused. At most one event: first the must-fire ones (.9 .5 .13 .4, no wait for the lock), then .1, then a 10% roll for .2 (design 3.3).
oe_itp_events = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_q9_ven } oe_itp_fire_9_ven = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_q9_gen } oe_itp_fire_9_gen = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_q5 } oe_itp_fire_5 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_q13_ven } oe_itp_fire_13_ven = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_q13_gen } oe_itp_fire_13_gen = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_q4_ven } oe_itp_fire_4_ven = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_q4_gen } oe_itp_fire_4_gen = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_q4_pis } oe_itp_fire_4_pis = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_q4_rag } oe_itp_fire_4_rag = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_itp_free = yes oe_itp_ok_1 = yes } oe_itp_fire_1 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_itp_free = yes oe_itp_ok_2 = yes } random = { chance = 10 oe_itp_fire_2 = yes } }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly: called by the main-line scheduler (gen_mainline_lock.py LINES, id 15 "itp", condition empty); no hook of its own. No X1 event at all before 1338.1.1 (design 3.2): queued must-fire events wait until then.
oe_itp_monthly = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_itp_on } } oe_itp_init = yes }
    oe_itp_sync = yes
    if = { limit = { oe_itp_paused = no current_date >= 1338.1.1 } oe_itp_events = yes }
}

# BYZ scope. .1 the Venetian treaty expires (optional event: cooldown). Stores the haggling chance for the event text and the AI.
oe_itp_fire_1 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_itp_hgch value = oe_itp_haggle_ch }
    set_variable = { name = oe_itp_cd value = 8 }
    oe_itp_take = yes
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_itp.1
}

# BYZ scope. .2 an Italian loan: the lender is drawn among Venice and Genoa, weighted by their opinion of us. oe_itp_e2_up: the tier option a would reach (0 = none).
oe_itp_fire_2 = {
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { oe_itp_cand2_ven = yes oe_itp_cand2_gen = yes } }
        if = { limit = { oe_itp_cand2_ven = yes } c:VEN = { add_to_list = oe_itp_c2 } }
        if = { limit = { oe_itp_cand2_gen = yes } c:GEN = { add_to_list = oe_itp_c2 } }
        random_in_list = {
            list = oe_itp_c2
            weight = {
                factor = 2
                modifier = { add = 2 opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= 25 } }
                modifier = { add = 2 opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= 50 } }
                modifier = { factor = 0.5 opinion = { target = c:BYZ value < 0 } }
            }
            save_scope_as = oe_itp_pick
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_tgt_2 value = scope:oe_itp_pick }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_e2_up value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { scope:oe_itp_pick = { tag = VEN } }
            if = {
                limit = { var:oe_itp_t_ven ?= 2 oe_itp_room_ven = yes }
                set_variable = { name = oe_itp_e2_up value = 3 }
            }
            else_if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_t_ven ?= 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_itp_e2_up value = 2 } }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { scope:oe_itp_pick = { tag = GEN } }
            if = {
                limit = { var:oe_itp_t_gen ?= 2 oe_itp_room_gen = yes }
                set_variable = { name = oe_itp_e2_up value = 3 }
            }
            else_if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_t_gen ?= 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_itp_e2_up value = 2 } }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_cd value = 8 }
        oe_itp_take = yes
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_itp.2
    }
}

# BYZ scope. .4 a reprisal from Venice: one of our ships burnt if their navy is larger and we have one, else a fine of 1 month of income; then the event.
oe_itp_fire_4_ven = {
    remove_variable = oe_itp_q4_ven
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:VEN }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_tgt_4 value = c:VEN }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_why_4 value = 1 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_rep_why_ven ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_itp_why_4 value = 2 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_e4_room value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { oe_itp_room_ven = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_itp_e4_room value = 1 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_e4_slot value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_sunk value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { navy_size < oe_itp_navy_ven any_country_sub_unit = { is_ship = yes } }
            random_country_sub_unit = { limit = { is_ship = yes } destroy_subunit = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_itp_sunk value = 1 }
        }
        else = { add_gold = { value = oe_itp_m1 multiply = -1 } }
        oe_itp_take = yes
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_itp.4
    }
}

# BYZ scope. .4 a reprisal from Genoa: one of our ships burnt if their navy is larger and we have one, else a fine of 1 month of income; then the event.
oe_itp_fire_4_gen = {
    remove_variable = oe_itp_q4_gen
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:GEN }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_tgt_4 value = c:GEN }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_why_4 value = 1 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_rep_why_gen ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_itp_why_4 value = 2 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_e4_room value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { oe_itp_room_gen = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_itp_e4_room value = 1 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_e4_slot value = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_sunk value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { navy_size < oe_itp_navy_gen any_country_sub_unit = { is_ship = yes } }
            random_country_sub_unit = { limit = { is_ship = yes } destroy_subunit = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_itp_sunk value = 1 }
        }
        else = { add_gold = { value = oe_itp_m1 multiply = -1 } }
        oe_itp_take = yes
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_itp.4
    }
}

# BYZ scope. .4 a reprisal from Pisa: a fine of 1 month of income; then the event.
oe_itp_fire_4_pis = {
    remove_variable = oe_itp_q4_pis
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:PIS }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_tgt_4 value = c:PIS }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_why_4 value = 1 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_rep_why_pis ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_itp_why_4 value = 2 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_e4_room value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { oe_itp_room_pis = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_itp_e4_room value = 1 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_e4_slot value = 3 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_sunk value = 0 }
        add_gold = { value = oe_itp_m1 multiply = -1 }
        oe_itp_take = yes
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_itp.4
    }
}

# BYZ scope. .4 a reprisal from Ragusa: a fine of 1 month of income; then the event.

    remove_variable = oe_itp_q4_rag
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:RAG }

        if = { limit = { oe_itp_room_rag = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_itp_e4_room value = 1 } }

    }

# BYZ scope. .9 the foreigners expelled: Venice's pledge has been cut by the sync; they hold it against us.
oe_itp_fire_9_ven = {
    remove_variable = oe_itp_q9_ven
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:VEN }
        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_tgt_9 value = c:VEN }
        c:VEN ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_pledge_broken target = c:BYZ } }
        oe_itp_take = yes
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_itp.9
    }
}

        set_variable = { name = oe_itp_tgt_13 value = c:VEN }
        oe_itp_take = yes
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_itp.13
    }
}

    }
}

# BYZ scope. .13 Genoa's pledge falls due.

# BYZ scope. .5 after Galata (the Galata privileges were abolished; the sync already lowered Genoa).
oe_itp_fire_5 = {
    remove_variable = oe_itp_q5
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:GEN } oe_itp_take = yes trigger_event_non_silently = oe_itp.5 }
}

# BYZ scope; scope:oe_itp_lender saved. The lender gives BYZ a loan of $amt$ (a script value of BYZ) at $int$ a year ($int_ban$ after the author's ban on foreign banks) for $months$ months, under loc key $key$. The lender is funded first, as vanilla flavor_byz_ven.2 does.
oe_itp_lend = {
    save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_itp_amt value = $amt$ }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_foreign_banks_banned }
        scope:oe_itp_lender = {
            add_gold = scope:oe_itp_amt
            give_loan = {
                target = c:BYZ
                amount = scope:oe_itp_amt
                interest = $int_ban$
                months = $months$
                set_loc_key = $key$
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        scope:oe_itp_lender = {
            add_gold = scope:oe_itp_amt
            give_loan = {
                target = c:BYZ
                amount = scope:oe_itp_amt
                interest = $int$
                months = $months$
                set_loc_key = $key$
            }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. The loan job of Venice (var oe_itp_jb_loan on it): 1 oe_itp_borrow by tier; 2 .2 b (6 months of income at 6%); 3 interest-free 10 months of income for 120 months; 4 interest-free 6 for 60.
oe_itp_loan_ven = {
    c:VEN = { save_scope_as = oe_itp_lender }
    if = {
        limit = { c:VEN = { var:oe_itp_jb_loan ?= 1 } }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_itp_t_ven ?= 1 }
            oe_itp_lend = { amt = oe_itp_m4 int = 0.08 int_ban = 0.09 months = 60 key = oe_itp_loan_ven }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_itp_t_ven ?= 2 }
            oe_itp_lend = { amt = oe_itp_m8 int = 0.06 int_ban = 0.07 months = 60 key = oe_itp_loan_ven }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_itp_t_ven ?= 3 }
            oe_itp_lend = { amt = oe_itp_m12 int = 0.04 int_ban = 0.05 months = 60 key = oe_itp_loan_ven }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { c:VEN = { var:oe_itp_jb_loan ?= 2 } }
        oe_itp_lend = { amt = oe_itp_m6 int = 0.06 int_ban = 0.07 months = 60 key = oe_itp_loan_ven }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { c:VEN = { var:oe_itp_jb_loan ?= 3 } }
        oe_itp_lend = { amt = oe_itp_m10 int = 0 int_ban = 0 months = 120 key = oe_itp_loan_ven }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { c:VEN = { var:oe_itp_jb_loan ?= 4 } }
        oe_itp_lend = { amt = oe_itp_m6 int = 0 int_ban = 0 months = 60 key = oe_itp_loan_ven }
    }
}

# BYZ scope (the hidden worker oe_itp.99). For each slot: the loan first (it reads the tier before a shift), then down, then up.
oe_itp_run_jobs = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:VEN c:VEN = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_loan } }
        oe_itp_loan_ven = yes
        c:VEN = { remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_loan }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:VEN c:VEN = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_dn } }
        oe_itp_dn_ven = yes
        c:VEN = { remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_dn }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:VEN c:VEN = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_up } }
        oe_itp_up_ven = yes
        c:VEN = { remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_up }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:GEN c:GEN = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_loan } }
        oe_itp_loan_gen = yes
        c:GEN = { remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_loan }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:GEN c:GEN = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_dn } }
        oe_itp_dn_gen = yes
        c:GEN = { remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_dn }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:GEN c:GEN = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_up } }
        oe_itp_up_gen = yes
        c:GEN = { remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_up }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:PIS c:PIS = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_loan } }
        oe_itp_loan_pis = yes
        c:PIS = { remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_loan }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:PIS c:PIS = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_dn } }
        oe_itp_dn_pis = yes
        c:PIS = { remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_dn }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:PIS c:PIS = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_up } }
        oe_itp_up_pis = yes
        c:PIS = { remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_up }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:RAG c:RAG = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_loan } }
        oe_itp_loan_rag = yes
        c:RAG = { remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_loan }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:RAG c:RAG = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_dn } }
        oe_itp_dn_rag = yes
        c:RAG = { remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_dn }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:RAG c:RAG = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_up } }
        oe_itp_up_rag = yes
        c:RAG = { remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_up }
    }
}

# Any scope. One debug-log line with X1's state (tiers, claims, treaty months, frozen, loans owed).
oe_itp_log = {
    debug_log = "OE_ITP p1 v=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_itp_t_ven').GetValue|0] g=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_itp_t_gen').GetValue|0] p=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_itp_t_pis').GetValue|0] r=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_itp_t_rag').GetValue|0] c=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_itp_ven_claims').GetValue|0] pact=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_itp_ven_pact_m').GetValue|0] fz=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_itp_frozen_v')|0] lp=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_itp_lapsed_v')|0] l=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_itp_loan_left')|0]"
}

# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope. Back to the start (ven 2, gen 2, pis 1, rag 1): every X1 modifier, X1 relation, tier-bound opinion, timer, mark and job goes; the quarters seen at init stay. The Galata / B1 / B2 results are read again next month.
oe_itp_test_reset = {
    oe_itp_clear_ven = yes
    oe_itp_clear_gen = yes
    oe_itp_clear_pis = yes
    oe_itp_clear_rag = yes
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_ven_pact_m } remove_variable = oe_itp_ven_pact_m }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_ven_lapsed } remove_variable = oe_itp_ven_lapsed }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_ven_frozen } remove_variable = oe_itp_ven_frozen }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_ven_claims } remove_variable = oe_itp_ven_claims }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_cd } remove_variable = oe_itp_cd }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_seen_gal } remove_variable = oe_itp_seen_gal }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_seen_cw2v } remove_variable = oe_itp_seen_cw2v }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_seen_ten } remove_variable = oe_itp_seen_ten }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_seen_disp } remove_variable = oe_itp_seen_disp }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_seen_turin } remove_variable = oe_itp_seen_turin }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_q5 } remove_variable = oe_itp_q5 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_tgt_2 } remove_variable = oe_itp_tgt_2 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_tgt_4 } remove_variable = oe_itp_tgt_4 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_tgt_9 } remove_variable = oe_itp_tgt_9 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_tgt_13 } remove_variable = oe_itp_tgt_13 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_why_4 } remove_variable = oe_itp_why_4 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_sunk } remove_variable = oe_itp_sunk }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_e2_up } remove_variable = oe_itp_e2_up }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_e4_room } remove_variable = oe_itp_e4_room }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_e4_slot } remove_variable = oe_itp_e4_slot }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_hg } remove_variable = oe_itp_hg }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_hgch } remove_variable = oe_itp_hgch }
    c:VEN ?= {
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_bcd } remove_variable = oe_itp_bcd }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_pcd } remove_variable = oe_itp_pcd }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_loan } remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_loan }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_up } remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_up }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_dn } remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_dn }
    }
    c:GEN ?= {
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_bcd } remove_variable = oe_itp_bcd }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_pcd } remove_variable = oe_itp_pcd }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_loan } remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_loan }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_up } remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_up }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_dn } remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_dn }
    }
    c:PIS ?= {
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_bcd } remove_variable = oe_itp_bcd }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_pcd } remove_variable = oe_itp_pcd }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_loan } remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_loan }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_up } remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_up }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_dn } remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_dn }
    }
    c:RAG ?= {
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_bcd } remove_variable = oe_itp_bcd }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_pcd } remove_variable = oe_itp_pcd }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_loan } remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_loan }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_up } remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_up }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_jb_dn } remove_variable = oe_itp_jb_dn }
    }
    set_variable = oe_itp_on
    oe_itp_set_start = yes
}

# TEST PAGE ONLY. .1 now: the Venetian treaty falls due (frozen dealings thawed).

    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_ven_frozen } remove_variable = oe_itp_ven_frozen }
    oe_itp_fire_1 = yes
}
